name: Bay Mini-Grants
summary: Annual small grants for community-led restoration and education projects in the Tampa Bay watershed, open to nonprofits, businesses, schools and some government agencies but not individuals.

status.quote: May 6, 2026: Application period opens. June 17, 6-7pm, and July 29, 11am-12pm: TBEP staff hold informational webinars for interested applicants. Attendance is optional but strongly recommended. Both webinars will provide the same information. There is no need to attend both. September 16, 5:00pm: Application period closes.

status.quote: The next application period will open in the summer of 2027 and will close in the fall of 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Nonprofit organizations, businesses, and educational institutions are eligible to receive grant funds. Government agencies may apply if a project has strong volunteer or community involvement.

geography.quote: Projects must be within the Tampa Bay watershed.

access.quote: Bay Mini-Grants are competitive awards that fund environmental restoration and education projects in the Tampa Bay watershed with a focus on community-led initiatives.

window.quote: The next application period will open in the summer of 2027 and will close in the fall of 2027.

amount.quote: The maximum award is $10,000 per project.

co_finance_required.quote: Matching funds are not required, but including other costs and funding can strengthen your application's competitiveness.
